sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these three-dimensional shapes has exactly 6 square faces?
What is the place value of the digit 7 in the number 4,725?
Which of the following is the best unit to measure the length of a pencil?
What comes next in the number pattern: 15, 20, 25, 30, __?
If you share 20 balloons equally among 4 children, how many balloons does each child get?
How many centimeters make up exactly 2 meters?
What is the predecessor of the number 3,000?
Which shape has no straight sides and no corners?
If a rectangle has two sides that are 5 cm long and two sides that are 3 cm long, what is it called?
What is the main difference between a square and a rectangle? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A square has four equal sides, but a rectangle only has opposite sides that are equal in length. Both shapes have four corners.

questions.question_text: Use the digits 3, 8, 1, and 5 to form the smallest and largest four-digit numbers. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The smallest four-digit number is 1358 because we arrange the digits from smallest to largest. The largest number is 8531, arranged from largest to smallest.

questions.question_text: If a blue ribbon is 1 meter long and a red ribbon is 45 centimeters long, what is their total length in centimeters? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Since one meter equals one hundred centimeters, we add one hundred to forty-five. The total length of both ribbons together is exactly 145 centimeters.

questions.question_text: Look at the pattern: 2, 4, 8, 16. What is the next number and what is the rule? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The next number in the pattern is 32. The rule for this sequence is to double the previous number, or multiply it by two each time.

questions.question_text: Riya has 36 pencils to share equally among 6 pencil boxes. How many pencils go into each box? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the answer, Riya needs to divide the 36 pencils by 6 boxes. Each pencil box will contain exactly 6 pencils because 6 times 6 is 36.

questions.question_text: A tailor bought 5 meters of cloth. He used 2 meters and 50 centimeters to make a dress. How much cloth is left? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, we convert 5 meters to 500 centimeters. Then, we subtract the 250 centimeters used for the dress. 500 minus 250 equals 250 centimeters. Therefore, the tailor has 2 meters and 50 centimeters of cloth left over for his next project.

questions.question_text: The Cleanest Village has 2,450 adult residents and 1,120 children. If 500 people move away, what is the new total population? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, add the adults and children to find the total population, which is 2,450 plus 1,120, giving 3,570. Next, subtract the 500 people who moved away from that total. The new total population of the village is now exactly 3,070 residents.

sections.section_name: Section D - Mathematical Expression & Data Analysis

questions.question_text: Describe the properties of a standard brick. Mention its 3D shape name, and the exact number of faces, edges, and corners it has. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A standard brick is a three-dimensional solid shape known mathematically as a cuboid. It is made up of exactly six flat rectangular faces. When you examine the shape closely, you can count twelve straight edges where the faces meet, and eight pointed corners, also called vertices, completing its solid geometric structure.

questions.question_text: Create a repeating geometric pattern using a circle and a triangle. Explain how it repeats and how you would find the 10th shape in the sequence. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The pattern starts with one circle followed by one triangle, then repeats: circle, triangle, circle, triangle. Because the sequence has a core of two shapes, all odd positions will be circles and all even positions will be triangles. Since 10 is an even number, the tenth shape will definitely be a triangle.
